purpose: construction-time check of isolated-atom cutoff dependence; not staged, not used for any graded value
notes: W atoms here are offset by +0.006 Ry from the archive at both cutoffs (pseudopotential file revision or QE 6.7 vs 7.0); the cutoff difference is reproduced to 0.5 meV.

Ti 60 Ry reproduces the archived atom to 1e-7 Ry. Ti 35 Ry stopped at electron_maxstep=80 with scf accuracy 5e-9 Ry; Ti 60 Ry was stopped after 27 SCF iterations with scf accuracy 7e-8 Ry. Both energies are converged far below the 0.5 meV difference.
Conclusion: the TiB2 Ti reference (60/480 Ry atom with 35/280 Ry slabs) is numerically sound to < 1 meV; the W atom reused across cutoffs (30 vs 45 Ry) is off by 0.13 eV.
